verdict.rationale: Warp's site says you can use Warp from Claude, ChatGPT, and any MCP-speaking client, which means operating the product through natural-language agents. It also describes a first-party Warp Agent that handles onboarding, payroll, tax notices, and benefits, asks the user when a decision is theirs, and records every action. Missing for 10: documentation of the MCP server or the agent's natural-language command interface beyond marketing copy, specifics on which actions can be driven by natural language, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
